title: Z2 conformal/risk-control re-run on 160 OOD labels
why: PR #126 only had an OOD-60 note; re-evaluate the IndEgo-calibrated rule on the merged 160 labels with grouped CIs.
hypothesis: The distribution-free coverage guarantee does not transfer out-of-domain.
data: IndEgo oof_probs n=150 + labels/ood160_labels.json n=160 + frozen ood_scores{,2}.json
regime: fit on IndEgo only; OOD evaluation only
method: split conformal (clip LOCO) + CRC/LTT (unchanged) + OOD-160 transfer eval + frozen review/error frontier

summary: IndEgo rule at coverage 0.85 gives only 55.6% empirical coverage on OOD-160 (target 85%); frozen score near chance (AUROC 0.566 [0.413,0.704]); no OOD operating point.
